The shader formulas, glint constants and the CPU sources of the glint, UV and tint fields are unknown, so these draws are provisional: GLINT adds the client's actor glint (enchanted_actor_glint, its scroll, tint, worn-glint clock and glint accessibility settings, and shader-pack glint classification) instead of sampling MatTexture1; MULTIPLICATIVE_TINT weights the controller colour by the second texture's alpha; MASKED_MULTITEXTURE lays the second texture over the base by its alpha; COLOR_SECOND_TEXTURE tints the second texture of a three-sampler draw; with GLINT the tint or mask texture is taken from the slot after the glint texture. UV animation follows USE_UV_ANIM except for materials inheriting a native base the client declares itself, whose stand-ins lack the shipped defines. MULTI_COLOR_TINT and COLOR_BASED are not drawn: the client has no second tint colour and the ColorBased constant is not visible
